what: On first open, sixteen footprints walk diagonally across the panel, alternating left and right (12px off the step line, twisted ±8°) — horizontal panels go from lower left (24%, 74%) to upper right (98%, 44%), vertical panels from top to bottom. Each footprint starts .12s later, appears over 2.4s at 14% with .85, stays until 48% and then fades (power1.out) — pet site loader · with path: curve, they are placed every 58px along a random winding curve across the panel, as in the original.

options.cycle: How long a footprint appears before fading away (sec), default 2.4
options.side: Distance to step aside left and right in the step row (px), default 12
options.tilt: Angle (°) to twist the left and right footprints, default 8
options.from · to: Start and end of the step line on a horizontal panel (ratio of panel size 「x y」), default 「.24 .74」·「.98 .44」
options.from-tall · to-tall: Start and end of the vertical panel, default ‹.42 -.02› · ‹.8 1.02›
options.loop: If on, after the last footstep it walks again from the start — default is once (loader)
options.path: with curve, like the original, a random quadratic curve is drawn outward from outside the panel (horizontal panel from left −80px → right +232px, vertical panel from below +80px → above −232px) and one footprint is placed per gap — the footprint count is set by the curve length, and the length changes every time it opens (sui-brand is path: curve; side: 11)
options.gap: path: gap between curve footprints (px), default 58

note: Footprint shape is our own SVG (sole + four toes). Re-place it when the plate size changes

from.where: shared.js loader paw prints (.sr-loader__paws — original formula: random quadratic curve from outside the panel to outside, one paw every 58px, left-right 11px, skipping the card and date spots, PAW_CYCLE 2.4 · PAW_STAGGER .12 · opacity .85). path: curve; side: 11
